ticker.name: Bluerock Acquisition Corp. II Class A Ordinary Shares

business_summary: Bluerock Acquisition Corp. II focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or business combination with one or more businesses. Bluerock Acquisition Corp. II was formerly known as Bluerock Crunch Investment Corp. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: Bluerock Acquisition Corp. II는 하나 이상의 기업과의 합병, 합병, 주식 교환, 자산 인수, 주식 구매, 재편성 또는 사업 결합을 수행하는 데 중점을 둡니다. Bluerock Acquisition Corp. II는 이전에 Bluerock Crunch Investment Corp로 알려졌습니다. 이 회사는 2025년에 설립되었으며 뉴욕주 뉴욕에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
